description: This Dart file defines a helper utility class FirebaseMessagingService for managing Firebase Cloud Messaging integration in a Flutter app. It provides methods to initialize Firebase, request notification permissions, and retrieve the device's FCM registration token.

classes.name: FirebaseMessagingService
classes.description: A utility class to handle Firebase Cloud Messaging initialization, permission requests, and device token retrieval.

methods.name: ensureInitialized
methods.description: Ensures that Firebase is initialized. Safe to call multiple times, with subsequent calls being no-ops.

methods.name: requestPermission
methods.description: Requests notification permissions from the user; mainly relevant for iOS/macos.

methods.name: getDeviceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the current FCM device token, initializing Firebase and requesting permissions if necessary.
